text:
julia (Docs): Opened a small PR to tighten LumenX-4B model card: add explicit supported-quant list, fix embed-dim, add a compact perf table (512/2048), and a short migration note for q4_0 users. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12611 cc @noah @ara @matt

noah (Eng ML): Copying quick bench results: a100x2 fp16 -> 319 tok/s @512, 139 tok/s @2048. t4 q4_1 -> 94 tok/s @512. Embed dim should be 2048 (was 1024). I'll attach CSV to the PR.

ara (Runtime): Runtime note: recommend runtime 1.9+ for best quant kernels. q4_0 often falls back to CPU or OOM on older drivers. Docs should list supported quant tags: fp16, q4_1, q5 and call out "avoid q4_0 for GPU deployments." Also add quick check: `redwoodctl runtime show-version`.

matt (DevEx): I'll add two concise SDK snippets: python streaming generate with max_new_tokens, and embed() with shard_hint; plus a tiny Node tokenization note. I'll keep examples under 8 lines.

clair (QA): Latency checks: p50 ~29ms/token (512 fp16), p95 ~73ms. For 2048 p50 ~65ms. On t4 q4_1 p50 ~99ms. Proposed perf table (compact): seq512 / seq2048 rows with throughput/p50/p95.

julia (Docs): Two editorial asks: 1) add explicit "quant tags supported" bullet in compatibility; 2) short migration note titled "If you're using q4_0" explaining upgrade path and linking runtime guide.

noah (Eng ML): Adding a one-liner about quality: small degradation on long-form summarization when using int8; reference promptset id promptset-2026-10-lumenx.

ara (Runtime): Operational note for Private deploys: when CPU fallback triggers, memory increases ~30% during KV rehousing and latency can spike. Suggest a troubleshooting flag: `--log-quant-fallback`.

matt (DevEx): Pushed python snippets and node example. Updated snippet to use `client.streamGenerate` per SDK v3 naming.

ci-bot (bot): PR #12611: lint OK, link-check OK, mdx build OK.

julia (Docs): Merging once migration note and the operational memory figure are in. Will backport embed-dim fix to legacy catalog. Thanks all!
